chunk.content: The Gascoyne-Lyons Oreochromis mossambicus population was reported as highly stunted, maturing at a mean standard length of 9 cm versus about 18 cm in other populations; this is population-specific.
chunk.source_quote: The available evidence suggests that the O. mossambicus population in the Gascoyne-Lyons system (24°S; 166°E) is highly stunted, reaching maturity at a mean standard length of 9 cm as opposed to populations from other locations which reach maturity around 18 cm (Blühdörn and Arthington, 1990).

source.title: Tilapias as Alien Aquatics in Asia and the Pacific: A Review
source.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
